SELECT C.*,
,
,
,
FROM CONTENT C INNER JOIN CONTENT_ASSOC CA ON C.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO INNER JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE PERM ON PERM.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND PERM.ATTR_NAME = 'permission' INNER JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE TIT ON TIT.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND TIT.ATTR_NAME = 'title' INNER JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE LIN ON LIN.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND LIN.ATTR_NAME = 'link' LEFT JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE CLA ON CLA.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND CLA.ATTR_NAME = 'classes' WHERE
#{item}
AND ( CA.FROM_DATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND ( CA.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR CA.THRU_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) AND CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'TREE_CHILD' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_LOGIN_SECURITY_GROUP ULSG LEFT JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_CONTENT SGC ON ULSG.GROUP_ID = SGC.GROUP_ID WHERE ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId} AND SGC.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO ) ORDER BY CA.SEQUENCE_NUM ASC

SELECT C.*,
,
,
FROM CONTENT C INNER JOIN CONTENT_ASSOC CA ON C.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO INNER JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE TIT ON TIT.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND TIT.ATTR_NAME = 'title' LEFT JOIN CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE CLA ON CLA.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO AND CLA.ATTR_NAME = 'classes' WHERE CA.CONTENT_ASSOC_TYPE_ID = 'TREE_CHILD' AND (CA.FROM_DATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (CA.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR CA.THRU_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE LIN WHERE LIN.ATTR_NAME = 'link' AND LIN.CONTENT_ID = CA.CONTENT_ID_TO ) ORDER BY CA.SEQUENCE_NUM ASC
